proposals.currentTarget: أحدث من أحدث النسخة المذكورة
proposals.proposedTarget: أحدث من أحدث إصدار مُدرج
proposals.rationale: The current phrase is awkward and does not cleanly express the listed version as the comparison point; this keeps the “newer than the latest listed version” relation.

proposals.currentTarget: Neuer als neueste aufgeführte Version
proposals.proposedTarget: Neuer als die neueste aufgeführte Version
proposals.rationale: The comparison target needs the definite article in German; the current wording reads like a missing-article fragment.

proposals.currentTarget: Plus récent que la dernière version enregistrée
proposals.proposedTarget: Plus récent que la dernière version répertoriée
proposals.rationale: “Répertoriée” matches a version being listed more precisely than “enregistrée”; the masculine comparison refers to the current item.

proposals.currentTarget: 최신으로 등록된 버전보다 최신입니다
proposals.proposedTarget: 목록에 표시된 최신 버전보다 더 새로운 버전입니다.
proposals.rationale: The current wording repeats “latest” and does not clearly say that this item is a newer version than the latest one listed.

proposals.currentTarget: Mais recente do que a versão listada
proposals.proposedTarget: Mais recente que a versão mais recente listada
proposals.rationale: The current text omits that the comparison version is the latest one listed.

proposals.currentTarget: Mới hơn phiên bản mới nhất
proposals.proposedTarget: Mới hơn phiên bản mới nhất trong danh sách.
proposals.rationale: The current text omits the “listed” qualifier, which distinguishes this status from a comparison against any latest version.

proposals.currentTarget: أحدث إطلاق
proposals.proposedTarget: أحدث إصدار
proposals.rationale: “إطلاق” means a launch; “إصدار” is the appropriate release/version label for the release-year sort option.

proposals.currentTarget: Neueste Release
proposals.proposedTarget: Neueste Veröffentlichung
proposals.rationale: The current phrase uses the English noun “Release” with awkward German inflection; “Veröffentlichung” is clear and idiomatic for this sort label.

proposals.currentTarget: Le plus récent
proposals.proposedTarget: Les plus récents
proposals.rationale: This is a shelf tab for the newest games, so the plural label fits the collection better than the current singular “Le plus récent”.

proposals.currentTarget: Pas de couverture
proposals.proposedTarget: Aucune jaquette
proposals.rationale: The caller uses this as the placeholder inside a game-cover art area; “jaquette” identifies the game cover more clearly than the broader “couverture”.

proposals.currentTarget: Kein DAT Katalog wird in ROMarrNG geladen
proposals.proposedTarget: In ROMarrNG ist kein DAT-Katalog geladen.
proposals.rationale: The current passive construction says that no catalog is being loaded; the source describes the current state that none is loaded.

proposals.currentTarget: Aucun catalogue DAT est chargé dans ROMarrNG
proposals.proposedTarget: Aucun catalogue DAT n’est chargé dans ROMarrNG.
proposals.rationale: French requires “n’est” after “Aucun”; the current translation omits the negative particle.

proposals.currentTarget: Nenhum catálogo DAT é carregado em ROMarrNG
proposals.proposedTarget: Nenhum catálogo DAT está carregado em ROMarrNG.
proposals.rationale: “Está carregado” describes the current loaded state; “é carregado” reads as a general passive process.

proposals.currentTarget: Không tìm thấy thư viện khởi động trên máy này
proposals.proposedTarget: Không tìm thấy thư viện nào của trình khởi chạy trên máy này.
proposals.rationale: “Thư viện khởi động” means a startup/boot library; this source means a game launcher’s library.

proposals.currentTarget: keine PIN gegeben
proposals.proposedTarget: Keine PIN angegeben
proposals.rationale: “PIN angegeben” is the idiomatic German wording for a missing supplied PIN; the current “PIN gegeben” is awkward.

proposals.currentTarget: Tidak ada PIN diberikan
proposals.proposedTarget: PIN tidak diberikan
proposals.rationale: The current word order is unidiomatic Indonesian; this says directly that no PIN was provided.

proposals.currentTarget: không PIN được cung cấp
proposals.proposedTarget: Chưa cung cấp PIN
proposals.rationale: The current word order is awkward Vietnamese; this is a natural concise error detail for a PIN that was not supplied.

proposals.currentTarget: कोई सुरक्षित कैननिक शीर्षक नहीं
proposals.proposedTarget: कोई सुरक्षित मानक शीर्षक नहीं
proposals.rationale: The current transliteration “कैननिक” is not a natural Hindi rendering of “canonical”; “मानक” conveys the standard/canonical title in this metadata context.

proposals.currentTarget: 安全なカノニックタイトルなし
proposals.proposedTarget: 安全な正規タイトルがありません
proposals.rationale: “正規タイトル” is the standard Japanese term for a canonical title; the current “カノニック” is an awkward transliteration.

proposals.currentTarget: Không có tiêu đề canonic an toàn
proposals.proposedTarget: Không có tiêu đề chuẩn hóa an toàn
proposals.rationale: The current “canonic” is an English-like form; “chuẩn hóa” conveys a normalized/canonical title in Vietnamese.

proposals.currentTarget: Keine sicheren Renames sind in diesem Paket bereit.
proposals.proposedTarget: Für diesen Stapel liegen keine sicheren Umbenennungen vor.
proposals.rationale: The current text leaves “Renames” in English and uses “Paket” for “batch”; this uses idiomatic German for safe rename operations in a batch.

proposals.currentTarget: No hay renombrados seguros preparados en este grupo.
proposals.proposedTarget: No hay cambios de nombre seguros listos en este lote.
proposals.rationale: “Renombrados” is an awkward noun here; “cambios de nombre” clearly describes the ready rename operations.

proposals.currentTarget: 没有安全的改名在这个包装中准备好。
proposals.proposedTarget: 此批次没有可执行的安全重命名操作。
proposals.rationale: The current “包装” means packaging/package, not a batch, and the sentence structure is unnatural; this names safe rename operations for the batch.

proposals.currentTarget: 沒有安全的改名在這個包裝中準備好。
proposals.proposedTarget: 此批次沒有可執行的安全重新命名作業。
proposals.rationale: The current “包裝” means packaging/package, not a batch, and the sentence structure is unnatural; this names safe rename operations for the batch.

proposals.currentTarget: 그런 친구가 없어
proposals.proposedTarget: 그런 친구가 없습니다.
proposals.rationale: The current wording is casual; the polite form better fits a user-facing API error and matches the formal register used by nearby Korean error translations.
